data.title: World’s top humanoid maker and its dancing robots waltz towards record IPO listing in China | CNN Business
data.description: The world’s largest humanoid robot maker by sales is set to list in Shanghai on Wednesday, with the initial public offering already having raised 6.1 billion yuan ($905 million) and more than 8,000 times oversubscribed, a record for the city’s tech-focused STAR market, which is seen as China’s version of the Nasdaq.
data.author: John Liu
